num_tasks: <int> Total number of tasks to be assigned across the assembly line.
cycle_time: <int> Maximum allowable total processing time at any single station.
num_stations: <int> Number of workstations arranged in series on the assembly line.
total_processing_time: <int> Sum of processing times across all tasks.
station_lower_bound: <int> Minimum number of stations required to accommodate the total processing time within the cycle time.
task_processing_times: <dict, key: '{task}'> Time required to complete each task.
precedence_arcs: <list[list[int]], shape [num_precedence_arcs][2]> Pairs of tasks where the first task must be assigned to a station no later than the second task.
num_precedence_arcs: <int> Number of immediate precedence relationships between tasks.
earliest_station: <dict, key: '{task}'> Earliest station to which each task may feasibly be assigned, based on cumulative predecessor processing times.
latest_station: <dict, key: '{task}'> Latest station to which each task may feasibly be assigned, based on cumulative successor processing times.
